_meta.updated: 2026-10-22 (directive: 3D compressible viscous ONLY; 2D inviscid charts and 2D Euler slabs are NOT references anymore)
_meta.purpose: External truth anchors for wing3d validation. Everything here is 3D compressible viscous (RANS). The OpenFOAM anchor leg must be 3D RANS (SA/SST, y+ resolved), NOT the Euler slabs. The TSD leg is inviscid full-potential by construction; it is graded against 3D viscous truth and the inviscid-viscous gap is part of its reported band, never hidden.
_meta.grade_rule: ctest PASS if |computed - pub| <= band. PENDING if the target's case/anchor does not exist yet (no FAIL).
_meta.note_on_m6: ONERA M6 (Schmitt & Charpin 1979, AGARD-AR-138) provides Cp only. CL/CD are grid-converged SA-neg RANS reference values (TMR MRR level 4; AIAA 2018-1102 / Diskin et al. grid convergence; CFL3D/FUN3D/USM3D families).

flow.source: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource '3D ONERA M6 Wing Numerical Analysis' (SA-neg, MRR level 4): M=0.84, alpha=3.06, sharp trailing edge (AIAA 2016-1357 CAD); grid-converged CL/CD from NASA Langley grid families (CFL3D/FUN3D/USM3D, AIAA 2018-1102). Experiment (Schmitt & Charpin, AGARD-AR-138 1979) is Cp-only.
